home.subtitle: Here's your NetForge workspace.
home.profileDesc: Update your details, password, two-factor, and active sessions.
home.securityDesc: Turn on two-factor authentication and review where you're signed in.
home.dashboardDesc: Customizable widgets, charts, and quick actions land in a later phase. For now, set up your account.

tour.welcomeDesc: Here's a 60-second tour of the essentials. You can skip anytime, and replay it later from your account menu.
tour.navDesc: Jump between sections here. You only see what your role grants — the rest stays hidden.
tour.commandDesc: Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K) anywhere to search and jump to pages, users, settings, and more.
tour.tenantDesc: Move between the workspaces you belong to. Branding and data follow the one you pick.
tour.notificationsDesc: Real-time alerts land here — mentions, assignments, and system events.
tour.themeDesc: Toggle the theme, or follow your system setting. Every screen is designed for both.
tour.accountDesc: Profile, preferences, sign-out — and a "Take a tour" entry to replay this anytime.
tour.doneDesc: Explore at your own pace. Start by adding a widget to your dashboard or browsing the demo data.

ribbon.lead: This demo is the NetForge starter itself.
ribbon.detail: Configure it, download it, host it anywhere — the AI builder is optional.

banner.title: This is the NetForge starter — and it's yours to own.
banner.body: Pick the features you want and download a standard ASP.NET Core + React app on the database you choose, then host it anywhere. No AI required.
banner.aiLead: Prefer to describe your app instead?
banner.aiBody: NetForge AI builds on this very starter, tuned for the stack — and a real developer is there to help whenever you need it, at no extra cost.

tour.title: Make it yours
tour.desc: Everything you just toured ships in the NetForge starter — configure it, download it, and it's a standard ASP.NET Core + React app on the database you pick. NetForge AI is an optional shortcut on the same starter: use it to tailor the template before you download, or to build (and even host) your whole app with an AI tuned for this exact stack.
